theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) with Neo-brutalist / Claymorphic tactical influences

anti_patterns: Avoid standard flat cards; make interactive elements feel 'pressable'.
design_philosophy.core_strategy: Mobile-first experience optimized for touch. Use bold, contrasting elements with thick structural borders. UI must feel like a game rather than a textbook. Immediate visual feedback (color, motion) on every action.

global_rules.anti_default: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

headings.usage: H1, H2, large numbers (XP, Streaks), celebratory banners.

body.usage: Lesson text, quiz options, UI labels.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mobile-first single column, expanding to max-w-md or max-w-lg centered on desktop to mimic mobile app layout (Duolingo style).

spacing_scale.bottom_padding: pb-24 (to account for fixed mobile nav)

surfaces.tactile_cards: bg-white border-2 border-slate-900 rounded-3xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] transition-transform

components_strategy.global: Use purely custom HTML/Tailwind for primary layouts. Heavily customize standard shadcn components if used, removing 'Vercel-look'.
components_strategy.top_bar: Sticky header. Must contain counters: Hearts (Red), XP (Yellow), Streak Flame (Orange) with heavy font weights and Lucide icons.
components_strategy.bottom_nav: Fixed at bottom. Icons + labels. Active state gets a Violet background pill or underline.

buttons.primary: bg-violet-500 text-white border-b-4 border-violet-700 rounded-2xl py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg hover:bg-violet-400 hover:border-b-2 hover:translate-y-[2px] active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-[4px] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-900 border-b-4 rounded-2xl py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg hover:bg-slate-50 active:border-b-2 active:translate-y-[2px]

quiz_options.default: bg-white border-2 border-slate-300 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center cursor-pointer hover:border-violet-500 hover:bg-violet-50

learning_trail.design: Vertical scrolling path. Circular nodes connected by dashed SVGs. Completed nodes are Violet/Green. Current node is pulsing Violet. Locked nodes are Slate-200.
learning_trail.node: w-20 h-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-4

transitions.stagger: List items (quiz options, subjects) must fade in with a staggered delay (0.1s).

animations.celebration: Use canvas-confetti on lesson completion. Scale up XP text momentarily when earned.

logo.usage: Auth screens, Top Nav bar on home page

icons.usage_rules: Use stroke-width 2.5 or 3 for a chunkier, friendlier look. Colorize strictly based on gamification meaning (e.g., Flame is always Orange).

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST implement 'Bricolage Grotesque' via Google Fonts for headings and 'Nunito' for body text.

Do NOT use generic minimal cards. Everything interactive must have thick borders (border-2 border-slate-900) and hard offset shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#0F172A]) to create a 'clickable' tactile game feel.
The UI must be constrained to a mobile layout (max-w-md or max-w-lg mx-auto) on desktop, simulating a mobile app view.
Implement the 'Learning Trail' on the home page with a vertical zig-zag flex or grid layout, resembling Duolingo's path.
Include `data-testid` attributes on all buttons, quiz choices, and nav items.
Ensure quiz interaction gives instant state feedback (green/red) before proceeding to the next question.
